title: What's new: Enhanced Financial Reporting (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Author features - Account usage and filter transparency
Author features - Preview and defaulting capabilities
User features - Report packs and scheduling
Administrator features - Change log and auditing

features.name: Uncategorized accounts views
features.description: Two new saved views added to the chart of accounts page to help authors discover GL accounts that lack categorization or have missing subcategories, making it easier to ensure all accounts are properly categorized.

features.name: Where used for GL accounts
features.description: The where used action on the account card now includes data from which financial report definitions would include that account, allowing authors to track account usage in reports.

features.name: Totaling line account visibility in row definitions
features.description: A new fact box on row definitions shows which accounts are covered by a totaling line filter, and allows navigation directly to the GL account list for further investigation.

features.name: Totaling field account visibility in column definitions
features.description: Column definitions with GL account totaling filters now also include a fact box showing which accounts the totaling filter includes.
caveats: GL account totaling on columns is not commonly used

features.name: Preview capability for row and column definitions
features.description: Authors can set a default column definition when working on a row definition and vice versa, with a test button to preview the full report without leaving the definition page.
features.status_evidence_quote: The latter is coming in a minor version of 29, but I'll show you here.
caveats: Coming in a minor version of 29

features.name: Defaulting for row and column definition lines
features.description: When adding lines of the same type in row or column definitions, the system now defaults to the previously used settings, making data entry easier.
features.status_evidence_quote: Also coming in a minor to 29 is defaulting. So if you work on a row or column definition and add the lines of
caveats: Coming in a minor version of 29

features.name: Report packs
features.description: Users can now create report packages that run multiple reports in one operation and produce a single consolidated PDF. Packages support custom filters per report and start/end date filters, and can be scheduled.

features.name: Change log for financial report definitions
features.description: Change log is now automatically set up on all financial report definitions, enabling automatic auditing of changes to financial reports, row definitions, and column definitions without manual configuration.

features.name: Report inbox APIs
features.description: New APIs for report inbox operations allow external systems to interact with scheduled reports, enabling automation such as triggering other workflows or using AI to analyze report output.
